title: Zone de Sensibilité Picturale Immatérielle (Web Series)
summary: An International Klein Blue void you can acquire only by burning the receipt the page mints — a transaction that completes by destroying its own proof and keeping zero record.
mechanism: A per-visit JS-minted receipt with a unique serial held only in closure; 'burn' irreversibly nulls it and the page persists nothing (no storage, cookies, server, or token), so reload shows no transaction ever existed.
references: Yves Klein, Zones of Immaterial Pictorial Sensibility (1959-1962)
Yves Klein, the receipt-burning ritual on the Seine (1962)
